name: kost-survival-overlap-v1
hypothesis: The separate survival term may overlap with KOST's survival path; compare removing one path and removing the separate survival family.

definitions.kost_without_survival: For each player-round, 1 if opponent kill OR verified player objective OR death traded; no survival path. Keep separate survival/rounds.
definitions.kost_only: Original KOST/rounds, omit the separate survival rate.

control: Original KOST/rounds plus survival/rounds. Reuse saved model and CV results without refit.
fixed: All other available raw families unchanged, eight-second trade differential, kills beyond first, opening differential, objectives excluded; ridge alpha 1.
split: 299 clean pre-August rows across seven event-held-out folds; fit all 299 and evaluate 32 August EWC development rows. Both September events excluded; NA final 60 sealed.
decision: Compare fold and August errors, coefficient signs/stability, and objective-positive residual labels after fitting. Do not treat public objective credits as model inputs. Preregistered before fitting.
